name: Pedron the Wicked
description: A figure the order wanted to protect the Immortal Sun from.

timeline.summary: Malcolm explains the history of the Immortal Sun, stolen from Torrezon and carried west.
timeline.quote: a winged being descended from the sky. It took the Immortal Sun

timeline.summary: In the telling, Pedron the Wicked kills the guardians of the Immortal Sun and a winged beast steals the Sun from him.
timeline.quote: Pedron the Wicked killed them all.

timeline.summary: Elenda explains her order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not use it, and that she sealed herself away here.
timeline.quote: Our order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not to use it.

relations.note: his forces stole it from the monastery
relations.quote: Pedron the Wicked's forces broke into the monastery where the Immortal Sun was kept safe and stole it.

pages_say.description: A ruler whose forces broke into the monastery and stole the Immortal Sun.
The betrayer who, in Mavren Fein's telling, killed the nuns who guarded the Immortal Sun in Torrezon.
A figure the order wanted to protect the Immortal Sun from.
